section_summary: This section contains correspondence, applications, and clearance notices regarding commercial travel to and from occupied Japan in late 1948. It documents the processing of entry permits for foreign business representatives—including nationals of Iraq, South Africa, Lebanon, and Burma—by the State Department, the Department of the Army, and SCAP. Additionally, it includes a political adviser despatch on proposed SCAP regulations to allocate foreign exchange to Japanese exporters for overseas business travel, as well as administrative adjustments to permit notification procedures following the closure of the State Department's Exit Permit Unit.
